<function name="IsError" parent="IMaterial" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns whenever the material is valid, i.e. whether it was not loaded successfully from disk or not.</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Is this material the error material? (___error)</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
